title: Hunts FH-031S: Put the Event finale on the player and author screens
detail:
FH-031 built the finale read model and its gate (lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts, lib/hunts/rally-finale-store.ts) and nothing calls them from a screen yet. Owed: (1) the author picks the host Event in the Trail editor, limited to Events of the Hunt's own Space or a live partner, and publish writes it to hunt_versions.policy.finale.event_id; (2) the player's Trail page shows the finale panel from loadRallyFinale (the Event, places left, the player's seat or the reason there is none, a link to the Event page) and never a button that claims a seat; (3) the first route that grants a completion reward calls grantFinaleReward, and hunt_reward_grant gets the same seat check in SQL so the rule does not rest on one caller; (4) an Event stop credits through hunt_claim_apply with finaleDoorEvidence at assurance event_door. Done when a finished player with no seat at a full host Event sees the full message on a preview deployment and holds no RSVP, ticket or reward afterwards. Requires FH-016, FH-021 and FH-030. Hunts switches stay OFF.

Built 2026-11-16. Author: the Trail editor's publish step offers a Finale event picker (HUNT_MANIFEST field finaleEventId, a reference loaded by the surface) listing upcoming published Events the Hunt may end at: its own Space's or a live partner's, or, for a member's own Hunt, Events that member hosts (canHostFinale in lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts). The pick rides on the publish tap; publishTrail re-reads the choices and refuses a pick that is no longer allowed, then freezes it as hunt_versions.policy.finale.event_id (no finale writes no key). A new draft version carries the finale forward. Player: app/(main)/hunts/[slug]/play/page.tsx calls loadRallyFinale for the signed-in run and renders components/hunts/finale-panel.tsx: the Event, the places left, the player's ticket or RSVP or the refusal message, and a link to the Event page; no control that claims a seat, and a failed read shows no panel. Tests: components/hunts/finale-panel.test.tsx, app/(main)/hunts/[slug]/play/finale.test.tsx. Not built here, filed as FH-031T: the completion reward route calling grantFinaleReward with the matching SQL seat check in hunt_reward_grant (needs a migration), the Event stop crediting through hunt_claim_apply with finaleDoorEvidence, and the preview-deployment check. No migration, switches stay off.
